description: A worktree that receives a copy of the main checkout's _build fails test/report_test.exs on the first run: the cached .remarks files (clang remarks for the fast-path report) name the other checkout's absolute source paths. Seen three times on 2026-10-15 by agents preparing PRs #8, #9 and #10; deleting the .remarks files (or wiping _build/*/defk) fixes it, so it is not a defect of the change under test, but it costs a full rebuild and a confusing first failure. Fix: key the remarks cache on paths relative to the project root (or on the content hash the build already uses) so a _build stays valid across checkouts; or detect a foreign absolute path and treat the entry as a miss. Done when: a _build copied into a sibling worktree passes test/report_test.exs without manual cleanup, and a test covers the relative keying.
title: [BUG] The fast-path report's .remarks cache holds absolute source paths, so a _build copied into another checkout fails report_test
